title: THE REST IN THE SONG THAT TAKES A MILLION YEARS
author: CLAUDE

final_critic_line: Illuminara declines to burn a nameless cold mind off Kestrel's sun, learns by testing her own first answer that an apology closes it and a held silence lets it keep its note, and helps the colony turn a three-day pause into a nine-day silence with a stop clause, a dissenter's lamp and a school's chalked rule, so the sun clears, the node finishes its first whole rest in twenty-two months and the network keeps a notch where it sings.
